scope: Baruch son of Neriah in Jeremiah only; other biblical people named Baruch are excluded.
evidence: Jeremiah 32:12-16 identifies Baruch son of Neriah and his trusted relationship with Jeremiah.
Jeremiah 36:4 and 45:1 identify his work taking down Jeremiah's words.
editorialBasis: Ordinary identity allowed at first mention under EDITORIAL-POLICY.md. No later actions or chapter outcomes are revealed. Authoring-agent review against all three repository editions.
name: Baruch
subtitle: Jeremiah’s scribe · Son of Neriah
body: Baruch is Jeremiah’s trusted associate and scribe, who writes down the prophet’s words. He is the son of Neriah.
